## Runtime verdict
Its first line is exactly one of:
- `CONFIRMED` — [...]
- `NOT-MET` — [...]
- `SYMPTOM-PERSISTS` — [...]
- `NEEDS-DEVICE` — [...]
- `UNAVAILABLE` — [...]

Diff applies plan: yes|no (bug only; `n/a` otherwise) — compare `git diff --stat` and the files of `04-implementation.md` with `03-plan.md`; never paste the diff.
